analysis: The PR changes only docs/reference/protocol-messages.md. The sole hunk (head lines 170-174, near the graceful-drain text) adds that a lifecycle drain on a provider with no registered session completes without a drain acknowledgement once accepted work and local response writes finish (ProviderLoop+Lifecycle.swift, performLifecycleDrain). The supplied units (base lines 574-1213) are unchanged context; I read them for consistency and found nothing that interacts with the new text. The change is documentation only. It adds no wire message, field, authorization or encryption behavior, and does not touch the prefix-cache, model-replacement or attestation contracts shown in the context (T-041, T-053, TB-002). The described behavior could matter for availability or drain-correctness: a drain with no session must not skip a barrier that fences admission, and must not drop in-flight response writes. The no-session case has no coordinator to acknowledge, and the text explicitly waits for accepted work and local writes to finish. The Swift implementation (ProviderLoop+Lifecycle.swift) is not in the supplied evidence, so I cannot confirm the code matches the description. A later pass should check that performLifecycleDrain does not reopen admission or bypass the model-replacement and update fences. No threat-model update appears needed.
